title: Paradiski Full Catalog Curation - normalized model migration
summary: Migrates PR #9 onto the normalized Snowcast catalog. Facts are assigned to explicit regions, stay destinations, stay bases, ski areas, access edges, terrain domains, pass products, and rental facts. Source-aware v2 enrichment follow-up: Reviewed La Plagne, Les Arcs, Plagne Centre, Arc 1800, and Paradiski facts against official resort and operator sources. Added official piste-map links, supported snow and activity facilities, ski-day and local apres profiles, and stay-base elevation and character facts.

ranking_impact_summary: Ranking-relevant facts now attach to the normalized ski-area, stay-base, and access-edge owners; Search V3 scoring policy is unchanged.
unresolved_caveats: La Plagne local total_lift_count is unresolved because official pages currently expose conflicting local counts: 73 lifts in ski-pass scope and 77 lifts on the piste-map page.
Piste kilometers by difficulty remain unresolved for Les Arcs, La Plagne, and Paradiski because official sources publish difficulty by run counts rather than kilometers.
La Plagne 2026/27 public price values are not published yet; the default Paradiski price examples use the linked Les Arcs Essential Pass page as representative pricing.
Accommodation and rental price ranges remain estimate-backed pending a reviewed lodging/rental tariff sampling policy.
Source-aware v2 enrichment follow-up: No official La Plagne snowmaking coverage value or denominator was found, so its snowmaking fact remains unknown.
Source-aware v2 enrichment follow-up: Les Arcs publishes 600 snow machines and a 70 km supply network but no piste-length coverage percentage, so only availability is recorded.
